name: CF Industries
description: Nitrogen fertilizer and industrial-chemicals producer; describes itself as the world's largest producer of ammonia and operates the Donaldsonville, Louisiana complex with six world-scale ammonia plants, five urea plants, four nitric acid plants, three urea ammonium nitrate plants and a diesel exhaust fluid plant.

sources.note: CF Industries 'Who We Are' page (company introduction, 2,700 employees, 2016 capacity expansion, low-carbon ammonia facility), read 2026-11-17
